description: Quick Start overview: guests, CPU, memory, GPU and RDMA/TCP mesh at a glance.

panels.title: Guests Up
panels.description: Number of VMs where node-exporter is reachable. Requires VM_EXTRA_HOSTFWD=tcp::9100-:9100 and prometheus-node-exporter running in the guest.

panels.title: ROCm Ernic Instances
panels.description: Number of ernic NIC instances registered with the rocm-ernic mesh manager, as reported by the ernic-stats-exporter.

panels.title: RDMA Fleet Throughput
panels.description: Fleet-total RDMA byte rate broken out by operation type: SEND, RECV, RDMA Read, RDMA Write. From ernic-stats-exporter.

panels.title: TCP Mesh Fleet Throughput
panels.description: Total TCP/IP bytes per second over the ernic TAP network (fleet total TX + RX). This is the Ethernet layer beneath the RDMA mesh.

panels.title: GPU Up
panels.description: Number of VMs where amd-metrics-exporter (:9488) is reachable. Requires the amdgpu driver to be loaded and bound to the gfx1250 device.

panels.title: GPU Driver (amdgpu)
panels.description: Green = amdgpu_kfd_present == 1, which means amdgpu to be loaded and bound to the gfx1250 device.

panels.title: CPU Busy % Per VM
panels.description: CPU busy percentage per VM (100 − idle%), derived from node_cpu_seconds_total. Averaged across all vCPUs for each VM.

panels.title: Memory Used % Per VM
panels.description: Percentage of memory in use per VM: 100 × (1 − MemAvailable / MemTotal). Current snapshot, not a time series.

panels.title: System Load 1m Per VM
panels.description: 1-minute load average (node_load1) per VM. A value above the vCPU count indicates CPU saturation.

panels.title: Memory Available Per VM
panels.description: Bytes of memory available for new allocations (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes) per VM over time.

panels.title: GPU Utilisation % Per VM
panels.description: GPU compute utilisation percentage per VM, from amd-metrics-exporter. For emulated gfx1250 this reflects rocjitsu workload activity.

panels.title: VRAM Used Per VM
panels.description: Video RAM usage per VM. Shows used bytes against total VRAM capacity for the gfx1250 emulated device.

panels.title: GPU Power Per VM
panels.description: GPU power consumption in watts per VM, as reported by amd-metrics-exporter.

panels.title: GPU Temperature Per VM
panels.description: GPU die temperature in Celsius per VM. Emulated gfx1250 values are provided by rocjitsu.

panels.title: NVMe I/O Per VM
panels.description: NVMe (nvme0n1) read and write throughput in bytes per second per VM, from node-exporter disk stats.

panels.title: NVMe IOPS Per VM
panels.description: NVMe (nvme0n1) read and write I/O operations per second per VM, from node-exporter.

panels.title: rocm-ernic0 (ionic)
panels.description: Counts VMs where the emulated ernic NIC is visible to node_exporter, matched by its MAC prefix (72:6f:63:6d). Present = ionic driver is loaded and bound.

panels.title: ionic_rdma (RDMA exporter up)
panels.description: Counts VMs where rdma-metrics-exporter is reachable. Up = ionic_rdma module is loaded.
VMs with IB port in ACTIVE state from rdma_exporter hardware counters.
panels.title: IB Port Active

panels.description: RDMA link speed label from rdma_port_info per VM.
panels.title: Link Speed

panels.description: RDMA byte rates from rdma_exporter hardware counters on the ionic device (send/recv/read/write). Device-level, complementing ernic-stats mesh-level counters above.
panels.title: RDMA Bytes/s Per Device

panels.description: RDMA command rate per device from rdma_exporter. Admin queue commands to the ionic RDMA device.
panels.title: RDMA Commands/s Per Device
RDMA Throughput — Fleet Total
panels.description: Fleet-total RDMA byte rate broken out by operation type: SEND, RECV, RDMA Read, RDMA Write. From ernic-stats-exporter.

panels.title: RDMA By Node
panels.description: RDMA bytes per second per ernic node (current snapshot). Shows which nodes are active in the mesh.

panels.title: TCP Mesh Fleet Traffic
panels.description: TCP/IP bytes per second on the ernic TAP Ethernet network per direction (TX/RX). This carries RDMA signalling and out-of-band exchange.

panels.title: Doorbells & Completions — Fleet Total
panels.description: RDMA queue pair activity: send/recv doorbells ring when a WQE is posted; CQEs and WQEs track completions. A proxy for RDMA operation rate.

panels.title: RDMA Traffic By Node
panels.description: Per-node RDMA send/recv byte rate over time. Useful for spotting asymmetric traffic or stalled nodes.

hsa-snoop running and snooping HSA/AQL queues via kprobe on kfd_ioctl_create_queue. Requires CAP_SYS_ADMIN. Note: ring-buffer polling can interfere with GPU dispatch on emulated gfx1250 — use --no-ring-poll or --poll-us 0 on emulated devices.
panels.title: hsa-snoop Up

panels.description: Active HSA AQL queue count across all VMs. Each HIP/ROCm application typically opens 2 queues on startup.
panels.title: Active HSA Queues

panels.description: Name of the most recently observed GPU kernel dispatch, from hsa_last_kernel_launch_info. The label is the AQL packet function pointer address — hipcc embeds the kernel symbol name in later ROCm versions.
panels.title: Last Kernel Dispatched

panels.description: GPU kernel dispatch rate per second per VM. Each bar/spike corresponds to one or more HIP kernel launches observed in the AQL queue ring buffer.
panels.title: GPU Kernel Launches/s

panels.description: GPU kernel enqueue-to-completion latency percentiles from hsa-snoop. p50 = median, p95 = tail latency. On emulated gfx1250 these are longer than physical hardware.
panels.title: Kernel Duration (p50 / p95)
Container Logs
panels.description: Stdout/stderr from every compose-managed container in the stack, shipped by Alloy.
